title: 30 days of vibecoding my voxel war game
author: komorra
selftext:
This video shows current state of game progress after 30 days of using Claude with Codex. First I've build custom toolset and engine base, established on MonoGame framework. This toolset includes for example CLI tool for making voxel assets from prompts and reference images, tool for making explosions (fluid sim based) by baking them etc. Playable demo is available at: [https://komorra.itch.io/ironhost](https://komorra.itch.io/ironhost) , community links also:  
\- r/IronHost   
\- [https://www.facebook.com/playironhost/](https://www.facebook.com/playironhost/)
